A definition of disability for this purpose is available below.", "Definition": "Definition of Disability

As a general matter, \"disability\" for legal purposes means a physical or mental impairment that substantially limits one or more major life activities, or having a record of such an impairment, or being regarded as having such an impairment.

Major life activities includes things like caring for oneself, performing manual tasks, seeing, hearing, eating, sleeping, walking, standing, lifting, bending, speaking, breathing, learning, reading, concentrating, thinking, communicating, working, and the operation of a major bodily function (like the immune system, normal cell growth, or digestive, bowel, bladder, neurological, brain, respiratory, circulatory, endocrine and/or reproductive functions). An impairment that is episodic or in remission is a disability if it would substantially limit a major life activity when active.

The determination of whether an impairment substantially limits a major life activity is made without regard to the ameliorative effects of mitigating measures (such as medication, medical supplies, equipment, or appliances, some low-vision devices (see below), prosthetics including limbs and devices, hearing aids and cochlear implants or other implantable hearing devices, mobility devices, oxygen therapy equipment and supplies; use of assistive technology, reasonable accommodations or auxiliary aids or services, or learned behavioral or adaptive neurological modifications). Provided, however, that the mitigating impact of ordinary eyeglasses or contact lenses shall be considered in determining whether an impairment substantially limits a major life activity. Alcohol or drug addiction are generally considered disabilities, however: the current use of drugs or alcohol does not qualify as a disability if it prevents the individual from performing the duties of the job or if their employment would, due to the drug or alcohol use, constitute a direct threat to property or the safety of others.", "Label": "Please choose one of the options below:", "Options": { "Decline": "I don't wish to answer", "Disabled": "Yes, I have a disability (or previously had a disability)", "NotDisabled": "No, I don't have a disability" }, "Title": "Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability" }, "EEOC": { "Description": "This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal labor laws.         function escapeHtml(text) {
            if (text == null) return '';
            var div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = text;
            return div.innerHTML;
        }
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            if (urlParams.get('showBanner') === 'true') {
                const banner = document.getElementById('Successbanner');
                const bannerMessage = escapeHtml($.t("Common.QuickApply.SuccessBannerMessage"));
                const bannerAction = escapeHtml($.t("Layout.AccessibilityBanner.DismissMessage"));
                if (banner) {
                    var ugkBanner = document.createElement('ukg-banner');
                    ugkBanner.setAttribute('inline', '');
                    ugkBanner.setAttribute('type', 'success');
                    ugkBanner.textContent = bannerMessage;

                    var endDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    endDiv.setAttribute('slot', 'end');

                    var ugkButton = document.createElement('ukg-button');
                    ugkButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'banner-action');
                    ugkButton.setAttribute('emphasis', 'low');
                    ugkButton.textContent = bannerAction;
                    ugkButton.addEventListener('click', dismissBanner);

                    endDiv.appendChild(ugkButton);
                    ugkBanner.appendChild(endDiv);

                    banner.innerHTML = '';
                    banner.appendChild(ugkBanner);
                    banner.style.display = 'block';
                }
            }
        });
        function dismissBanner() {
            const banner = document.getElementById('Successbanner');
            if (banner) {
                banner.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

                function SkipToMainContent() {
                    var ele = $("#PageContainer");
                    if (ele.length > 0) {
                        var scrollTopValue = ele.offset().top;
                        // Toggle-aware scroll value: sanitize when security fix is enabled
                        var scrollValue = true
                            ? Math.floor(Math.max(0, scrollTopValue))  // Security ON: sanitize (safe integer, non-negative)
                            : scrollTopValue;                          // Security OFF: original (backward compatible)

                        $('html, body').animate({
                            scrollTop: scrollValue
                        });

                        var headingEle = ele.find('h1:first, h2:first').eq(0);
                        var focusableElement;
                        if (headingEle.length > 0) {
                            focusableElement = headingEle;
                        } else {
                            focusableElement = ele;
                        }
                        focusableElement.attr("tabindex", "-1").css("outline", "none").focus();

                        return false;
                    }
                }
